  field(DESC, "Bypass Status")
  field(SCAN, "1 second")
  field(DTYP, "asynUInt32Digital")
  field(ZNAM, "Not Bypassed")
  field(ONAM, "Bypassed")
  field(ZSV, "NO_ALARM")
  field(OSV, "MAJOR")
  field(INP, "@asynMask(CENTRAL_NODE $(ID) 1 1)MPS_FAULT_BYPS")
}
record(longout, "$(PV)_SCBYPD") {
  field(DESC, "Bypass duration in seconds")
  field(DTYP, "asynInt32")
  field(EGU, "Seconds")
  field(VAL, "0")
  field(PINI, "YES")
  field(OUT, "@asyn(CENTRAL_NODE $(ID) 1)MPS_FAULT_BYPEXPDATE")
  field(ASG,  "$(ASG2)")
}
record(longin, "$(PV)_SCBYPT") {
  field(DESC, "Remaining bypass duration in seconds")
  field(DTYP, "asynInt32")
  field(EGU, "Seconds")
  field(SCAN, "1 second")
  field(VAL, "0")
  field(PINI, "YES")
  field(INP, "@asyn(CENTRAL_NODE $(ID) 1)MPS_FAULT_REMAINING_BYPTIME")
}
record(stringin, "$(PV)_SCBYP_END") {
  field(DESC, "Bypass Expiration Date/Time String")
  field(DTYP, "asynOctetRead")
  field(SCAN, "1 second")
  field(VAL, "Invalid")
  field(PINI, "YES")
  field(INP, "@asyn(CENTRAL_NODE $(ID) 1)MPS_FAULT_BYPEXPDATE_STRING")
}

#================================================================================#
# LCLS-II MPS PV template for LCLS-I operator displays                           #
# Macro description:                                                             #
#   - P_DEV       : Record name prefix i.e. CBLM:UNDH:1375                       #
#   - FAULT       : Fault name from database (I0)                                #
#   - R_DEV       : fault descriptor name (LOSS or CURRENT, etc.                 #
#   - EGU         : Engineering units                                            #
#================================================================================#

record(ai, "$(P_DEV):$(FAULT)_$(R_DEV)") {
    field(DESC, "Analog input value")
    field(DTYP, "$(DTYP)")
    field(EGU, "$(EGU)")
    field(SCAN, ".1 second")
    field(INP, "$(INPV) NPP NMS")
    field(FLNK, "$(P_DEV):$(FAULT)_$(R_DEV)NORMH")
    info(autosaveFields, "AOFF ASLO EGU")
}
record(calc, "$(P_DEV):$(FAULT)_$(R_DEV)NORMH") {
    field(DESC, "Normalized analog value")
    field(INPA, "$(P_DEV):$(FAULT)_$(R_DEV) NPP NMS")
    field(INPB, "$(P_DEV):$(FAULT)_T0_LC1_H_RBV")
    field(CALC, "B=0?A:100*A/B")
    field(FLNK, "$(P_DEV):$(FAULT)_$(R_DEV)NORML")
    field(EGU, "%")
    field(SCAN, "Passive")
}
record(calc, "$(P_DEV):$(FAULT)_$(R_DEV)NORML") {
    field(DESC, "Normalized analog value")
    field(INPA, "$(P_DEV):$(FAULT)_$(R_DEV) NPP NMS")
    field(INPB, "$(P_DEV):$(FAULT)_T0_LC1_L_RBV")
    field(CALC, "B=0?A:100*A/B")
    field(EGU, "%")
    field(SCAN, "Passive")
}

#================================================================================#
# LCLS MPS PV template for Central Node Analog Devices - 1 per fault type        #
# Macro description:                                                             #
#   - P          : Device Input PV Prefix                                        #
#   - ID         : Device ID                                                     #
#   - INT        : Integrator number                                             #
#================================================================================#
record(bi, "$(P)_SCBYPS") {
  field(DESC, "Bypass Status")
  alias("$(P)_FLT_SCBYPS")
  field(SCAN, "1 second")
  field(DTYP, "asynInt32")
  field(ZNAM, "Not Bypassed")
  field(ONAM, "Bypassed")
  field(ZSV, "NO_ALARM")
  field(OSV, "MAJOR")
  field(INP, "@asyn(CENTRAL_NODE $(ID) $(INT))MPS_ANALOG_DEVICE_BYPS")
}

record(longout, "$(P)_SCBYPD") {
  alias("$(P)_FLT_SCBYPD")
  field(DESC, "Bypass duration in seconds")
  field(DTYP, "asynInt32")
  field(VAL, "0")
  field(PINI, "YES")
  field(OUT, "@asyn(CENTRAL_NODE $(ID) $(INT))MPS_ANALOG_DEVICE_BYPEXPDATE")
  field(ASG,  "$(ASG2)")
}

record(longin, "$(P)_SCBYPT") {

}

  field(DTYP, "asynOctetRead")

  field(VAL, "Invalid")
  field(PINI, "YES")

record(bi, "$(P)_SCBYPV") {

  alias("$(P)_FLT_SCBYPV")
  field(SCAN, "1 second")
  field(ZNAM, "OK")
  field(ONAM, "OK")
  field(ZSV, "NO_ALARM")
  field(OSV, "MAJOR")
  field(VAL, "0")

#   - EGU             : Engineering units                                        #
#   - PREC            : Precision                                                #
#   - PORT            : Asyn port name                                           #
#   - BAY             : Bay number (0 or 1)                                      #
#   - APP             : Application name (BLM, BPM, BCM, BLEN)                   #

#     * BLM  => (X)(Y), X=input channel(0-2), Y=Integration channel (0-3)        #
#     * BPM  => (X),    X=Channel (0:X, 1:Y, 2, TIMIT)                           #

#   - MPS_LINK_NODE_ID        : Link Node ID                                     #
#   - IS_LN                   : Boolean: True=LN, False=AN or DN                 #
#   - GROUP                   : Link Node Group                                  #
#================================================================================#

record(stringin, "$(P):LN_GROUP") {
  field(DESC, "Link Node Group")
  field(VAL, "$(GROUP)")
}

record(mbbi, "$(P):LN_TYPE") {
    field(DESC, "MPS Link Node Type")
    field(NOBT, "2")
    field(ZRVL, "0")
    field(ONVL, "1")
    field(TWVL, "2")
    field(VAL, "$(MPS_LINK_NODE_TYPE)")
    field(ZRST, "Digital")
    field(ONST, "Analog")
    field(TWST, "Mixed")
}
record(bi, "$(P):IS_LN") {
  field(DESC, "True=LN, False=AN/DN")
  field(VAL, "$(IS_LN)")
  field(ONAM, "True")
  field(ZNAM, "False")
}

record(ai, "$(P_DEV):$(R_DEV)") {

}

#================================================================================#
# LCLS-II MPS Threshold scale factor and offset PV template                      #
# Macro description:                                                             #
#   - P               : Record name prefix                                       #
#   - R               : Channel name.                                            #
#   - DESC            : Description                                              #
#   - SCAN            : Scan period                                              #
#   - SCALE_SLOPE_PV  : Name of the PV with the scale slope value                #
#   - SCALE_OFFSET_PV : Name of the PV with the scale offset value               #
#   - EGU             : Engineering units                                        #
#   - PREC            : Precision                                                #
#   - PORT            : Asyn port name                                           #
#   - BAY             : Bay number (0 or 1)                                      #
#   - APP             : Application name (BLM, BPM, BCM, BLEN)                   #
#   - CH              : Threhold channel (application specific)                  #
#     * BLM  => (X)(Y), X=input channel(0-2), Y=Integration channel (0-3)        #
#     * BPM  => (X),    X=Channel (0:X, 1:Y, 2, TIMIT)                           #
#     * BCM  => (X),    X=Channel (0:Charge, 1:Difference)                       #
#     * BLEN => 0                                                                #
#================================================================================#

# Scale Factor PVs
record(ao,      "$(P):$(FAULT)_SS") {
    field(DESC, "Scale factor slope")
    field(SCAN, "1 second")
    field(PHAS, "1")
    field(PINI, "YES")
    field(EGU,  "$(EGU)/raw")
    field(PREC, "4")
    field(OMSL, "closed_loop")
    field(OIF,  "Full")
    field(DOL,  "$(P):$(FAULT)_FWSLO")
    field(DTYP, "asynFloat64")
    field(OUT,  "@asyn($(PORT),$(BAY))$(APP)_SCALESLOPE_$(FAULT_INDEX)")

    field(DESC, "Scale factor slope")
    field(SCAN, "I/O Intr")
    field(EGU,  "$(EGU)/raw")
    field(PREC, "4")
    field(DTYP, "asynFloat64")
    field(INP,  "@asyn($(PORT),$(BAY))$(APP)_SCALESLOPE_$(FAULT_INDEX)")
}

    field(DESC, "Scale factor offset")
    field(SCAN, "1 second")
    field(PHAS, "1")
    field(PINI, "YES")
    field(EGU,  "raw")
    field(PREC, "0")
    field(OMSL, "closed_loop")
    field(OIF,  "Full")
    field(DOL,  "$(P):$(FAULT)_FWOFF")
    field(DTYP, "asynFloat64")
    field(OUT,  "@asyn($(PORT),$(BAY))$(APP)_SCALEOFFSET_$(FAULT_INDEX)")
}

    field(DESC, "Scale factor")
    field(SCAN, "I/O Intr")
    field(EGU,  "raw")
    field(PREC, "0")
    field(DTYP, "asynFloat64")
    field(INP,  "@asyn($(PORT),$(BAY))$(APP)_SCALEOFFSET_$(FAULT_INDEX)")
}

Boxcar
